summary: The supervisor-policy, adoption-price and gate-section walks spell one sequence three times — checker over one module, vacuity wrapper, anchored section — at ~90 lines each.
acceptance: One reader takes module, interface, vacuity member and heading anchor and yields the declared set plus the anchored section; the three describes call it, and every case keeps its title and its verdict.
notes: Target shape named by the build note on THE-SUPERVISOR-POLICY-SECTION-NAMES-ITS-KNOBS-ONCE. A fourth walk copies whichever is nearest, as eight `sectionOf` copies did before `docSections.ts`. Behavior-free: the typecheck and the three describes' own cases hold it.
